input.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
input.key_value: No blanket criminal-history bans; no convictions older than 5 years; no credit score use
input.requirement: In housing funded by or on land from Boston DND, or with income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy, providers may not use blanket bans on applicants with arrests or convictions. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, expunged or sealed convictions, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old, with exceptions for direct relationship or unreasonable risk. Credit scores may not be used to approve or deny applications.
input.coverage_conditions: Applies to housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.
input.exemptions: Does not apply where a conviction has a direct relationship to the housing sought or poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior.
input.quoted_span:
will not impose a blanket policy that denies 
housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on 
a case-by-case basis
